prompts.name: 01-home
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity website design presentation for Douglas D'Avila's engineering portfolio. This is a proposed design, not an implemented website. Create a generous landscape board with a large desktop page mockup on left (about 75% width) and a narrow mobile mockup on right, both fully legible, flat front-on, no device shells or perspective. Design world: minimalist daylight engineering studio, near-white #FAFBF8 background, deep green-black #202923 text, forest green #285B46 actions, pale sage #EDF2EA artifact backgrounds, fine neutral dividers. Humanist sans like Onest, moderate weight, restrained headings, NO serif, gradients, glowing elements, decorative blobs or dark fields. Desktop header Douglas D'Avila left, Work Experience Writing Lab About right plus small outlined Lab access. Calm spacing, confident alignment, evidence-led composition. Footer compact contact plus Porto Alegre, Brazil. Mobile 390px design with name and Menu, 20px gutters and proper stacked reading order. Text in English. Do not invent metrics, employers, awards, customer logos or testimonials. Each page needs a distinctive content structure within the SAME visual system. Render real plausible legible UI content using the exact titles supplied. Include small board label with page name and 'Design proposal'. HOME / WORK. Desktop full page with concise 2-line hero 'Quality systems, built for real delivery.' role SDET / Quality engineering / Practical AI, short supporting sentence and 'Explore selected work' green button plus 'View experience' text. A large open evidence artifact immediately below/right, titled 'User Story Quality Analyzer', showing Requirement → Risk → Test → Evidence with realistic password reset review, clearly labeled 'Illustrative example'. Then selected work: featured analyzer wide artifact, two compact flat links to Operational Context Graph and AI-Powered Document Generator. Below a compact career overview, latest writing with 2 titles, short about teaser, final 'Let’s talk about your next quality problem.' contact. Prefer 2-3 line headings, never narrow towers. Mobile show hero, workflow stacked vertically and first selected project. This page is continuous overview; navigation targets its sections.
